title: Owner-Domain Gameplay Operation, Objective & Route Runtime

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-17 and OARC-04 remain independently selected_not_started.

objective: Implement the common owner-domain operation adapter runtime over GPR-01 registry bindings and GPR-03 deterministic instance state for traversal, combat/projectiles, abilities, Resources, interactions, Inventory/equipment, Economy/rewards, Progression/unlocks, objectives/missions and World/Scene routes, while delegating every canonical mutation to its owning domain.
acceptance: Operation requests bind stable GPR registry IDs, GameplayInstance identity and explicit canonical owner-domain targets.
Traversal, combat/projectile, ability/resource, interaction, Inventory/equipment, Economy/reward and Progression adapters route through explicit owner seams rather than duplicate domain engines.
Objective/mission and route composition remain GPR-local orchestration and do not become canonical World/Scene/Quest truth.
Owner-domain mutation is considered committed only when an explicit owner receipt/evidence is returned; GPR-local success cannot prove owner mutation.
Unsupported, unknown or owner-mismatched operations fail closed with no generic fallback or inferred compatibility.
Declared deterministic operation ordering is stable and cannot be replaced by presentation-frame or network-arrival order.
boundaries: GPR-01 registry and GPR-03 deterministic kernel remain predecessors and are not duplicated.
MRCS remains reusable definition authority; canonical Action/Event, Combat, Inventory, Economy, Progression, World/Scene and other owners retain mutation truth.
GPR-05 composes typed requests/outcomes and objective/route state only; it may not create parallel canonical owner ledgers.
Later MRCS domains may late-bind without pausing GPR or MRCS execution.
GPR-06+ specialist modules, delivery modes, presentation, multiplayer/replay and final golden proof remain unauthorized.
MRCS and OARC lane state remain independent.
next_action: GPR-05 is completed_verified. GPR-06 — Specialist Puzzle, Sports, Vehicle, Party, Strategy, Social & Stealth Pattern Modules — is selected_not_started and requires a later GPR-specific owner Continue for governed start.
